title: Venezuelan Quesadilla
description: A vegan twist on the classic Venezuelan dish. This recipe features a crispy tortilla filled with melted cheese and savory flavors.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese and cheesy.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Cut into wedges and serve hot.
